title: [3.0beta11] NSClient does not see temp target
symptom: When a temp target is set either manually or via automation on AAPS phone, it cannot be seen on NSClient phone. The temp target appears in AAPS but not in NSClient's Treatments - temp target tab. It was observed that the issue occurs when an automation sets both a temp target and a temp profile.
cause: The issue is related to a bug in Nightscout (NS), specifically in the dev version. A commit on the nightscout dev caused the problem, and a fix was created in pull request #7285 but not yet part of NS.
fix: The user reverted their Nightscout site to master and could see temp targets in NSClient. The maintainer created a fix in https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/pull/7285 but it is not yet part of NS.
evidence_quote: I decided to revert to master on my nightscout site and can now see temp targets in NSClient. I suspect this commit on the nightscout dev is what caused this issue: https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/commit/aca8d5ab492f1e356c36f340102044dc961d82aa#diff-5a16ec3fb169ae3b2b0b4d0a810080d451c8910345d86280d1cc2c67d4a178a0
